metrics.name: googleSearchConsole.clicks
metrics.label: Clicks
metrics.description: Number of times users clicked through to your site from Google Search results.

metrics.name: googleSearchConsole.impressions
metrics.label: Impressions
metrics.description: Number of times your pages appeared in Google Search results.

metrics.name: googleSearchConsole.ctr
metrics.label: CTR
metrics.description: Click-through rate: clicks divided by impressions. Shown as a percentage in Search Console.

metrics.name: googleSearchConsole.position
metrics.label: Average position
metrics.description: Average ranking position of your pages in search results (lower is better).

dimensions.name: googleSearchConsole.country
dimensions.label: Country
dimensions.description: Country where the search user was located.

dimensions.name: googleSearchConsole.device
dimensions.label: Device
dimensions.description: Device category (mobile, desktop, or tablet) used for the search.

dimensions.name: googleSearchConsole.page
dimensions.label: Page
dimensions.description: Page URL of your site that appeared in Google Search results.

dimensions.name: googleSearchConsole.query
dimensions.label: Query
dimensions.description: Search terms users typed before seeing your site in results.

dimensions.name: googleSearchConsole.searchAppearance
dimensions.label: Search appearance
dimensions.description: How your content appeared in search results (e.g. AMP, rich result, web light, video).
